'''Running Crimson Three''' was the callsign of an unknown [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] flying a [[Blade series]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] during the [[Adumari Civil War]]. The starfighter was destroyed at the early stages of the conflict. It is not known whether the pilot survived the explosion.<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>
